definitions.explanation: A device fastened around the ankles to restrain a person. Used literally for physical restraints.
Something that restricts freedom of action or progress. Commonly used figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{囚人|しゅうじん}→囚人：20680_shuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{足|あし}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめた。
examples.english: They put shackles on the prisoner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{足|あし}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}された→外す：02394_hazusu⟧。
⟦{鎖|くさり}→鎖：02658_kusari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足|あし}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけられたまま{歩|ある}かされた。
examples.english: He was made to walk with chain shackles still on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{足|あし}かせになっている。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{足|あし}かせ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Old rules are acting as a hindrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{足|あし}かせ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}できない→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: Past failures act as a fetter, preventing me from taking on new challenges.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot, leg) + かせ ({枷|かせ}, shackle) = leg shackle

WRITING:
Can be written as ⟦{足枷|あしかせ}→足枷：09983_ashikase⟧. The mixed form {足|あし}かせ is common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {足|あし}かせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a hindrance
- {足|あし}かせ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as an obstacle (slightly more formal)
- {足|あし}かせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめる: to put shackles on

USAGE:
The figurative sense (hindrance, burden) is more common in modern usage than the literal sense. Often used in news and business contexts to describe obstacles to progress.
